hypothesisMarkdown: Most of the warmed wide DataTable's 882 text measurement callbacks return through `TextLayout`'s existing same-element size reuse path, while only a minority proceed through full text layout. Measuring that partition will show whether the remaining opportunity is callback/Taffy overhead or repeated text shaping.
measurementPlanMarkdown: Add diagnostics-only per-frame counters for `TextLayout` local size reuse and full-layout execution, publish them through the existing frame telemetry, and assert that they partition text measurement calls. Run focused tests, full gpux and WGPU tests, production and diagnostic checks, formatting, clippy, and headed WebGPU Test Suite validation at DPR 1 and DPR 2 while preserving established layout and renderer invariants.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown: Local size reuse should account for most of the 882 text measurement callbacks, with full text layout closer to the 229 measured leaves than to 882. The two path counts must sum exactly to text measurement calls at both DPRs, and all established wide DataTable invariants must remain exact.

reportMarkdown:
## Text Measurement Path Telemetry Finished

**Index:** 57
**Checkpoint:** `f4bc6ad3fa268e115d8e919ae6a8b33ff09f90d2`
**Result:** `e0889ba80cc083a0e6eb4cb7a3f7127898588031`
**Attempt Count:** 1

### Report

**Passed Status:** true. Diagnostics-only text measurement counters partition each frame's text callbacks into the existing local-size reuse path and full text-layout execution without changing production layout behavior or public APIs.

The final headed wide DataTable result is exact at both DPRs: 562 of 882 text callbacks reuse `TextLayout`'s local size and 320 perform full text layout. Local reuse therefore serves 63.72% of callbacks, while full layout serves 36.28%. The two paths sum exactly to all 882 text measurements. Both cases retained 882 comparable stable outputs, zero changed outputs, exact final offset `-351402.6875`, zero browser errors, 1,123 nodes, 229 measured leaves, 82 root compute calls, nine batches, and 12 queue-buffer writes.

All 414 gpux unit tests and integration suites, all 52 serialized WGPU tests, production and diagnostics checks, focused formatting, Clippy with warnings denied, and two headed WebGPU cases passed.

### Scope Lock

Only diagnostics-gated path counters, bounded latest-frame telemetry publication, one focused drain oracle, and the Test Suite partition assertion changed. Production text measurement and caching behavior are unchanged.

### Decision

Accept the telemetry. Preserve `TextLayout`'s effective local reuse path and measure the 320 full-layout executions through `WindowTextSystem` before designing a text-owned cross-frame key. The 562 local hits do not justify hashing content and style on every callback without evidence that key construction is cheaper.
decisionMarkdown: Accept diagnostics-only text path classification. The existing local cache serves 562/882 callbacks at both DPRs, so preserve it. Measure current-frame, previous-frame, and platform-shaping work within the remaining 320 full layouts before adding any text-owned cross-frame key or invalidation mechanism.
